title: Orkay Tiles International case study
h1: How Orkay Tiles *runs its leads* on GoHighLevel
meta_title: Orkay Tiles case study: GoHighLevel and AI | Artificia AI
meta_description: How Artificia set up and runs Orkay Tiles International's two GoHighLevel accounts, with language routing, an AI voice agent and a new website.

fields.statement: GoHighLevel, a website and n8n workflows, run by us.
fields.eyebrow: Case study, shared with Orkay's permission
fields.subheading: Orkay Tiles International, a tile manufacturer in Morbi, Gujarat, is our client. We set up and run its two GoHighLevel accounts, built its website and deployed it on AWS, and created the n8n workflows that handle its daily lead data.

fields.heading: What we *built*
fields.summary: Two GoHighLevel accounts, an AI voice agent, n8n workflows for the daily lead data, and a new website on AWS.
fields.challenge:
Orkay sells to tile dealers across India over WhatsApp, and to importers abroad by email. Leads arrive from ads and forms, in many languages.

Each one has to reach the right rep quickly and never be forgotten.

built.title: India dealer account
built.text: Dealer and distributor leads, handled WhatsApp-first in Hindi and regional languages.

built.title: International export account
built.text: Importers, distributors and project buyers abroad, worked by email.

built.title: Routed by language
built.text: Tamil, Telugu and Kannada form leads go to the rep who speaks that language.

built.title: Arya, the AI voice agent
built.text: Arya calls new India leads in Hindi.

built.title: Meta Conversions API
built.text: Each new Facebook and Instagram lead in the India account is reported back to Meta as a lead event.

built.title: Follow-up
built.text: India leads get an automatic follow-up 18 hours later.

built.title: Daily status report
built.text: Every morning the team gets a report of new leads, stage moves and conversations.

built.title: n8n workflows
built.text: Workflows in n8n handle each day's lead data: they book calls from the voice agent and follow up on leads nobody has answered.

built.title: The website, on AWS
built.text: We built orkaytiles.com, with collection pages and an admin the team edits, and deployed it on AWS.

fields.heading: From ad click to *the right rep*
fields.body:
A dealer fills in a Meta form or messages on WhatsApp, and GoHighLevel gives the lead an owner.

Tamil, Telugu and Kannada form leads go to a rep who speaks that language.

Then Arya, an AI voice agent, calls the dealer in Hindi.

fields.heading: Automations that *run every day*
fields.body:
Our n8n workflows handle the daily lead data: they book calls from the voice agent, and India leads get an automatic follow-up 18 hours later.

Meta hears about every Facebook and Instagram lead in the India account, so the ads learn which clicks became enquiries. Each morning, a report shows the team what came in and what moved.
